## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6cfc783910a3bbdd0d94ec3750e8e051d6f3a8e6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (L133, L142), .claude/agents/os-dev.md (L355), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md (L17), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md (L7, L33, L37), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md (the `Restart-when:` and `Blocked-by:` line contracts B names) — all read on `origin/main` `52ff308b`

Face: governed rules text (`.claude/**`, Tier S); rendered in seat — `get_session` `last_served_model` equals the value of `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Inputs: the card (body and five comments, the post-dispatch note 6248946273 included), the PR diff read through git (`origin/main...refs/pm/24276`, +8/−8 over 2 files), the PR body, the head's 37 check-runs. ⛔ Not the dispatch order's conclusions; the dev's report was read for its machine fields only.

### ① Derived judgments

- A (`dispatch-runbook.md` L211–L213, three lines of 106, 113 and 110 bytes): trigger — a card's code first reads a key, type member or runtime behaviour that spec release R first publishes; duty — the same PR raises the consuming package's `@objectstack/spec` floor to R and the claim's file surface names the manifest and the lockfile specifier; boundary — 「不动 pin」 bans only the lockfile's resolved version and the `.objectui-sha`/console pin move, ⛔ never the floor. Each clause of the card's A maps to one line. 「lockfile 解析版本」 for the card's 「lockfile move」 is the only sharpening and it is forced: raising a floor rewrites the lockfile's `specifier:` line, which line 2 orders, so an unqualified lockfile ban would contradict line 2. Correct.
- A's placement: the section the dispatching seat reads while composing the file-surface sentences (〈派发词构造细则〉, two lines below 「文件面两句原文照抄」), not beside `cross-repo-coordination.md` L33 「⛔ pin bump 不做 rider」. Measured by the dev: one line beside L33 carries only the 110-byte boundary, never the duty. L33 and `lanes/ui.md` L20 are unchanged and neither contradicts A (they ban the pin as a rider; A is about the floor). Correct.
- B (`triage-duties.md` L30–L31, 115 bytes each): the bump card's waiting-card list is read from the hold index, the query and its hit count go in the body, a list from memory is not that list; hold index = every open card whose `Restart-when:` or `Blocked-by:` line names that release, version or upstream commit. Verbatim to the card's B; placed after the bump-card cap, where every bump card's writer reads. 「上游 commit」 keeps B valid under the objectui pin model ruled B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955 (note 6248946273). Correct.
- Payments, five, each verified on `origin/main` `52ff308b` as stated elsewhere: runbook L202 (the dev re-derives over its real paths) survives at `execution-duties.md` L133 and in `os-dev.md` 〈本地验证范围〉 ③; the runbook L232+L233 fold drops 「⛔ 静默略过」, which survives at `execution-duties.md` L142 「编译面清单逐面申报,⛔ 静默略过」 while the merged line keeps the failure mode 「评审把没提到的面读作漏掉」; runbook L235 (what a read-only dev does) survives at `os-dev.md` L355; the triage L39+L40 fold drops 「落卡必带四棱块…⛔ 不留待有人接手再补」, which survives at `filing-gate.md` L17 「落卡即带「维护者速读」与四棱块」, read at filing (triage-duties L41 points there); the triage L55+L57 fold drops 「分诊固定产出,分诊席唯一权威生产」, which survives at `cross-repo-coordination.md` L7 and L37. No payment is a re-wrap: three whole-line deletions and two folds that each drop a clause stated elsewhere. Ratchet 241/241 and 120/120 (`Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint & Repo Gates` success on the head); every touched line ≤ 120 bytes (widest 120, the `type` line).
- No issue or PR number in any rule line; no new gate, no ceiling raise, no `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` entry, no `scripts/pm/**` path. The incident stays on the card.
- Accept set and public surface: none touched. `.claude/**` is unpublished; `Clause-②: no` on the body's line 2 is right.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched; `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration (read back on the PR's labels). No semver level applies.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev raised no `open_questions`. One acceptance note (no line names the per-release objectui consumer bump card; B covers every bump card) is an observation outside the three filing classes — carried, not filed.
- The post-dispatch note 6248946273 (objectui seat): the maintainer's ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955 moves objectui to consuming `@objectstack/*` by commit; once objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 (floors computed from the pin at publish) lands, A is redundant for objectui; until then A holds, and the note changes no wording of the card. A as written is general (any consuming package's floor) and the maintainer's 「A 和 B 都要」 is not rescinded by that ruling, so A lands as ordered; the seat records a cross-lane memo to re-read A for retirement or re-scoping when objectui#12958 closes. B is unaffected.
- The report's JSON sits inside a fenced block under the plain-text `os-dev-report` first line; the marker scan reads it. Accepted as a formatting deviation, no rework.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24276-spec-floor-rider-hold-index`
Reviewed-by: `session_01V1upgJbYCZ5xed9pEQF4Tz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(终稿)

**改了什么**:PM 技能的两份参考文件各加一条规则,行数不变。A(`dispatch-runbook.md` 派发词构造细则):哪张卡的代码第一次用到 spec 某个新版本才有的键、类型或运行时行为,就在同一个 PR 里把该消费包对 `@objectstack/spec` 的下限抬到那个版本,认领的文件面点名 manifest 与 lockfile specifier;派发令里的「不动 pin」只管 lockfile 解析版本和 `.objectui-sha`/console pin,永不管下限。B(`triage-duties.md` bump 单段):bump 单的等待卡清单必须按 `Restart-when:`/`Blocked-by:` 行查出来,查询式与命中数写进正文,凭记忆列的不算。

**为什么改**:您在 objectui 席会话里的原话「下限提到 next.3我记得之前有一个升级任务,为什么没升级完整,以后如何避免。」与「立卡吧,A 和 B 都要」。next.3 那次两处漏:用上 next.3 类型的 PR 被「不动 pin」挡住没抬下限;bump 单凭记忆漏了一张等 next.3 的卡。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改席位读的协议文本,不碰代码、门禁、发布物;两文件都在棘轮天花板,新增 5 行由同文件删掉 5 行别处已写明的重复句付账,每处删除与存活位置列在 PR 正文表里,席位逐条在 `origin/main` 上核过。回滚 = revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**:ACCEPT,席内达档复核 PASS(见上一条评论)。一点需知:您在 objectui#12955 裁 B(objectui 按 commit 消费 `@objectstack/*`)后,objectui 席在卡上留注:objectui#12958(发布时按 pin 算下限)落地后,A 对 objectui 变为冗余,此前 A 仍成立。A 是对任何按 npm 区间消费 spec 的包的通则,您的「A 和 B 都要」未被撤,故照裁落地;本席记一条跨车道备忘,objectui#12958 关闭时重读 A 决定退役或收窄。B 不受影响(「上游 commit」已覆盖 pin 模型)。

**你要做的**:无需操作。Tier S,本席经中继 ready + auto-merge 入队。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT — PR #24315, head `6cfc7839`, reviewed by `session_01V1upgJbYCZ5xed9pEQF4Tz` (os-steve, `domain:skills#1`) against GitHub and `origin/main` `52ff308b`, not against the report.

1. **形态**: draft, base `main`, same-repo head; body line 1 `Fixes #24276`, line 2 `Clause-②: no`; the only closing keyword in the stored body is that `Fixes`; files = 2, both `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`, +8/−8; labels `skip-changeset` (correct: `.claude/**` publishes nothing), `documentation`, `size/s`; assignee `os-steve`; body carries `## 维护者速读(草稿)` with 席位意见 empty and ends with one session-URL footer; commit `bfec7efd` carries the model-free trailer pair; merge commit `6cfc7839` over `origin/main` `0b44840d` (one merge before the PR opened, AGENTS.md §10).
2. **前提实测**: both probes re-run by the seat at `ef65646` and by the dev at `21070a2` — A and B absent (0 hits each, control `Restart-when` 9 hits in 5 files); the card's ten referenced issues and PRs read live before dispatch (the incident closed by objectstack-ai/objectui#12943; the three objectui cards triage named are open `pm:blocked` with a line-anchored `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168`). `premise_still_valid: true` holds; the note 6248946273 narrows A's future for objectui, not its validity today (速读 席位意见 above).
3. **门禁 check-runs on `6cfc7839`**: 37 runs — 25 success, 12 skipped, 0 failure; `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Build Core` skipped; `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 24315` OK, all 12 skips in the roster. Dev side: 19 derived / 19 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED at the same head, exit codes captured before any pipe (listed in the PR body); the seat re-ran no gate locally.
4. **接受的偏差**: the report JSON sits in a fenced block under the plain-text `os-dev-report` line (marker readable; formatting only); three git pushes (probe, commit, merge); attribution follows AGENTS.md over the harness reminder (correct); mechanism assumption (d)'s L27+L28 fold refused by measurement (123 bytes) and the payment taken from the runbook instead — the order allowed either.
5. **范围外去向**: one acceptance note (no line names the per-release objectui consumer bump card; B covers every bump card) — carried on this seat's post, not filed; `carrier: none` is right for an observation. Cross-lane memo recorded on the seat post: re-read A when objectstack-ai/objectui#12958 closes.
6. **落地条款**: Tier S (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 24315`: 2 of 2 paths under `.claude/**`, 16 changed lines); contract review of record PASS on this head (the previous comment); every check green or an expected skip; `mergeable` true; no generated artifact on the surface (no `merge=os-regen` path); no `Restart-touch:` line on any open `pm:on-hold` card names either file (15 cards scanned, 1 such line, disjoint). The seat lands it now through the relay (`pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`) and follows it to MERGED.

`mcp_calls` 0 · `api_writes` 2 relay strokes (`pr_create` with assignee and label, the report comment) · `line_budget` 241→241 and 120→120, headroom 0 — machine fields read from the report and checked against the PR object and its labels.
